Class ColumnParallelLinear

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.parallel.ColumnParallelLinear
public final class ColumnParallelLinear extends Object
Megatron-style column-parallel linear: shards out_features across TP ranks. Input is replicated; output is the local shard (no gather).

Supports dense LinearLayer or quantized LinearOp (FP8 / NVFP4 / Marlin). Quantized weights must be sharded then packed before constructing this wrapper.

    • ColumnParallelLinear

      public ColumnParallelLinear(int inFeatures, int globalOutFeatures, boolean bias, int tpSize, int tpRank)
      Creates a dense column-parallel linear layer for the given TP rank.
      Parameters:
      inFeatures - input feature count.
      globalOutFeatures - global output feature count (must be divisible by tpSize).
      bias - whether to include a bias term.
      tpSize - tensor-parallel world size.
      tpRank - this rank in [0, tpSize).

    • ColumnParallelLinear

      Parameters:
      local - already-sharded local linear op.
      globalOutFeatures - global output feature count (must be divisible by tpSize).
      tpSize - tensor-parallel world size.
      tpRank - this rank in [0, tpSize).
